projects.title: Elmo and Friends
projects.description:
Following the launch of Sesame Street's TV series in the Albanian language, we were asked to produce a number of educational materials to be distributed to children in schools across Kosova. Each piece of work required careful application of guidelines for every Sesame Street character, in close co-operation with its creators in New York and UNICEF Kosova, bearing in mind the cultural diversity and proper adaptation.

The final execution consisted of over 100,000 printed educational materials for children, in the shape of activity books, flash cards, bags, posters, leaflets for pupils/teachers…
